text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yep! All done!
Rice—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Rice-chaaaaaan!!
You're amaaaazing!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: U-Urara-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~ I'm here~♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not! Please go back!
This is the Winner's Circle!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Wait, only people connected to the 1st place winner are allowed in...?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Then wouldn't that be fine?
We are related parties to Rice-san."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
That was a wonderful run,
Rice. First, let me congratulate you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"During races, you truly live up to the title
Rob Roy gave you: 'The Demon of Tenacity'—"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...A demon of pure tenacity?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
W-Wah!? Bourbon-san!!
I told you it was a secret that I came up with that nickname!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Rice really lived up to
everyone's expectations... in this race...!
choice_data_list: We managed to make everyone smile.
You managed to put a smile on everyone's face, huh?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, Rice-chan's all smiles too!
Make sure to smile lots at the next concert too, okay!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: "We'll wave our hands like crazy and cheer for Rice-chan too!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... You're right, Urara-chan.
I'll wave to everyone... too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Bigger... bigger,
so everyone can see...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Even so, I-I'm still
really nervous, though...!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: For Rice to be center stage at the Tenno Sho (Spring)...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. You did defeat me, after all,
so please hold your head high.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: M-McQueen-san!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, this stage is special.
However, once we step onto it, we are professionals.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Shouldn't we deliver more than just feelings of gratitude
to the people who are eagerly awaiting the concert?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Feelings of gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. To everyone who supports us.
To everyone who gives us that push forward.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Therefore, you must not fear the stage.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Living up to hopes and feelings and shining bright is the duty of anyone who runs in a race, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I am looking forward to it as well.
To seeing the brilliance of the spectacular running you showed us.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Mejiro McQueen,
graceful and noble, heads toward the stage.
choice_data_list: That was quite the lesson, huh.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Just as I thought, they were a wonderful person.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Rice has to live up to everyone's hopes and feelings too.
With a heart full of gratitude to everyone..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Bourbon and the others aren't the only ones
who came to this stage...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The people who watched Rice's race...
People are cheering for Rice...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...All right!
Rice is heading out!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower dashed out onto the glittering, radiant stage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And on the night of that day—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um... it might be strange to say this right after getting back, but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...You know what, Big Brother!
There's something Rice wants to try doing next!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...You know what, Big Sister!
There's something Rice wants to try doing next!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um... Rice wants to...
live up to everyone's expectations even more.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
When I stood on the stage, I saw it.
—So many lights.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
To think so many people...
were shining their light for Rice.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
That's why... I want to run in the Takarazuka Kinen next.
If everyone says it's okay, that is...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "—The Takarazuka Kinen. A stage open only to the Umamusume beloved by their fans."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...She who was crying all alone outside the academy at first
should now be worthy of that right.
choice_data_list: Next, let's enter the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Yeah!
Rice will do her best too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: And tell them—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...'Thank you,' huh?
